Sobre a vaga

Location: Remote or Hybrid

Type: Full-Time

Seniority: Senior / Lead

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong backend engineering expertise to lead the architecture, development, and scalability of our core systems. You will own backend services, APIs, data models, and cloud infrastructure.

While this role is primarily backend-focused, you'll also collaborate on React-based frontend applications as needed.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role with significant influence on product direction and engineering culture.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of backend services and APIs.
  • Architect scalable, secure, and highly available backend systems using cloud-native patterns.
  • Own DevOps initiatives, including CI/CD automation, observability, performance monitoring, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure (Lambda, API Gateway, EC2/ECS/EKS, S3, IAM).
  • Design and optimize NoSQL data models (MongoDB, DynamoDB, or similar).
  • Develop and maintain Node.js services and internal tooling.
  • Contribute to React-based frontends (React, React Native, Electron, Next.js) when needed.
  • Ensure backend systems follow security, compliance, and data protection best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ship features and resolve complex issues.
  • Mentor engineers and participate in technical planning and architectural decisions.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in backend-focused software engineering.
  • Strong experience with AWS services (serverless, compute, storage, IAM, networking).
  • Proficiency with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, or similar).
  • Advanced experience with Node.js or equivalent backend technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, communication abilities, and technical leadership.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • HealthTech, clinical workflows, or healthcare integrations.
  • Frontend development with React, Electron, Next.js, or React Native.
  • Offline-first or local-first application development (sync, conflict resolution, caching).
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS).
  • AI-powered features (AI transcription, summarization, chatbots, LLM integrations).
  • DevOps and infrastructure-as-code (CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, CDK, etc.).
  • Event-driven architectures (SQS/SNS, Kafka, etc.).
  • Security & compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2, LGPD).
  • Observability and monitoring tools (Sentry, Datadog, Prometheus).

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Ownership over backend and infrastructure strategy.
  • Opportunity to work with a modern, forward-looking tech stack.
  • Mission-driven team with a collaborative and supportive culture.
  • Flexible remote work options.

Even if this role isn’t the perfect fit, follow our journey — HosTalky is just getting started.

👉 Follow HosTalky on LinkedIn and join the movement to fix the disconnect in healthcare.

HosTalky® is a mobile and desktop app built exclusively for healthcare professionals. With tools powered by AI, it helps teams connect, collaborate, and stay organized like never before. Designed to ease the burdens of healthcare work, HosTalky enhances work-life balance while improving the quality of care. It’s more than just an app—it’s a step toward a unified, global healthcare community. Join us in transforming the way healthcare works.

Compromissos

Crescimento profissional e aprendizagem

At HosTalky®, we are dedicated to creating a world where healthcare professionals feel heard, supported, and empowered. Our mission is to build a system that truly makes life easier for healthcare workers—where they can seamlessly communicate their needs, express grievances, and connect with colleagues and peers across the globe. Through the power of CareID®, HosTalky® enables every healthcare worker to reach anyone, anywhere, fostering a united and compassionate healthcare community. Together, we are transforming the way care is delivered, ensuring healthcare workers have the tools they need to thrive—because those who care for others deserve to feel cared for, too.
